02 / Expertise

From analysis to coordinated design.

Project experience includes concrete and steel member design, foundation systems, and structural documentation for buildings of different scales.

01

Structural analysis & lateral response

Wind and seismic loading, torsional irregularities, drift assessment, and diaphragm response for varied building configurations.

02

Reinforced concrete & foundations

Shear walls, columns, beams and slabs, retaining walls, pressure slabs, driven piles, and foundations subject to moment, tension, or water pressure.

03

Steel framing & connections

Long-span trusses, special moment-resisting frames, steel deck systems, and connection checks where required by the project.

04

Drawings & coordination

Structural drawings and detailing with consideration for architectural requirements, fabrication, and constructability.

Software used across the selected projects

ETABSSAFESTAAD.ProIDEA StatiCaAutoCAD

03 / Approach

Start with the project constraints.

I start with the architectural intent and project constraints, then evaluate structural behavior and practical design alternatives.

When irregularities arise, I consider their implications for the lateral system and detailing. Structural analysis, member design, and coordinated drawings are developed around the project requirements.
